stories.title: Uniqlo opens fourth Bengaluru store at RMZ Ecoworld
stories.summary: Uniqlo has opened a 14,500-square-foot store at RMZ Ecoworld, its fourth location in Bengaluru. The retailer says the expansion brings its LifeWear clothing closer to professionals working in the city's technology hubs. The new site offers access to functional everyday apparel and personal styling services.

stories.title: Nigerian designer Oludayo Adeyemi targets UK market
stories.summary: Nigerian fashion entrepreneur Oludayo Adetunji Adeyemi is expanding his brand, ODA Atelier, into the United Kingdom. The label aims to promote indigenous Nigerian textiles, including Akwete and Ankara, by integrating traditional cultural heritage with contemporary garment construction and modern design silhouettes for an international audience.

stories.title: Shara’s Atelier wins contemporary fashion award
stories.summary: Feyishara Idayat Raji’s fashion label, Shara’s Atelier, was named Promising Contemporary African Fashion Brand of the Year at the 2024 African Fashion and Arts Award in South Africa. The recognition marks a milestone for the brand as it contributes to the evolving expression of contemporary African fashion.

stories.title: Santosham restaurant expands to Malad
stories.summary: Santosham, a temple-style South Indian vegetarian restaurant, has opened a 60-seater location in Malad. This marks the brand's first expansion into Mumbai’s western suburbs. The restaurant focuses on culinary traditions rooted in the philosophy of prasadam and family recipes for home-style cooking.

stories.title: Aarav Bhatia wears Rohit Bal in Jaipur
stories.summary: Aarav Bhatia attended Jaipur’s 300-year celebrations wearing a black ensemble from the late designer Rohit Bal. The appearance drew social media attention for the outfit and his resemblance to Bollywood figures from the industry's golden era. The celebrity son generally avoids the public limelight.

stories.title: Mini launches Paul Smith edition in India
stories.summary: Mini has launched its Paul Smith Edition range in India, with prices starting at 55.75 lakh rupees. Developed with the British designer, the vehicles feature unique color combinations and styling elements. The company says the edition focuses on design personalization rather than mechanical upgrades.

stories.title: Blissclub campaign challenges dress codes
stories.summary: Blissclub has launched 'The Wrong Outfit' campaign featuring actor Sobhita Dhulipala. The brand says the initiative promotes comfort in fashion while questioning conventional dress codes. The campaign aims to demonstrate that personal style and comfort can coexist across different settings without adhering to societal expectations.

stories.title: Ida’s Fashion Design Institute graduates 29 trainees
stories.summary: Ida’s Fashion Design and Training Institute has graduated 29 trainees from its skills program in Bakau. The curriculum focused on fashion design, entrepreneurship, and vocational education. Principal Chan Mendy urged the new graduates to continue refining their techniques and applying the skills acquired during their training.

stories.title: Grameen Mahotsav exhibition opens in Ahmedabad
stories.summary: The Grameen Bharat Mahotsav Gujarat 2026 has opened at Sindhu Bhawan in Ahmedabad. The three-day exhibition, organized by the Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India, features GI-tagged products and traditional crafts from across the country. The event aims to connect rural artisans directly with urban consumers.

stories.title: McQueen releases Pre-Fall 2027 collection
stories.summary: McQueen has released the imagery for its Pre-Fall 2027 fashion collection. The presentation features 30 looks from the upcoming season.

stories.title: Victoria Beckham expands retail footprint
stories.summary: Victoria Beckham says opening a New York flagship store has provided direct insight into customer preferences, allowing for more confident collection expansion. The designer described her Pre-Fall 2027 collection as a love letter to clients and an examination of the different identities women create through fashion.

stories.title: Emma Corrin wears Schiaparelli for Pride and Prejudice
stories.summary: Emma Corrin wore an olive-green velvet jacket from Schiaparelli’s 1938-inspired Spring 2027 collection to a photocall for the upcoming Pride and Prejudice adaptation. The cast was photographed at a Regency-inspired meadow installation in London ahead of the film's December 3 premiere.

stories.title: Princess Diana’s Niece Kitty Spencer Owns Fashion History From Family - InStyle
Feast Your Eyes on These 6 Memorable NFL Thanksgiving Weekend Fashion Moments - People.com
Weekly red carpet fashion roundup
stories.summary: Celebrity stylists showcased various luxury labels this week, including Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, and Valentino Haute Couture. Notable appearances included Selena Gomez, Elizabeth Debicki, and Monica Bellucci. The list highlights the designers currently favored for high-profile red carpet events and premieres.

stories.title: Chanel dominates Marrakech Film Festival red carpet
stories.summary: The 2026 Marrakech International Film Festival featured several looks from Chanel, including a pleated skirt ensemble worn by director Ramata-Toulaye Sy. The festival concludes this Saturday, capping off a week of red carpet appearances that also featured Miu Miu and other luxury fashion houses.

stories.title: Stylist addresses criticism of Julianne Hough’s outfits
stories.summary: Julianne Hough’s stylist has addressed public discourse regarding the co-host’s fashion choices on the 35th season of Dancing with the Stars. Fans have frequently criticized the outfits as bold or avant-garde, and the stylist confirmed they are aware of the ongoing commentary.

stories.title: Zara collaborates with kolor on World Uniform line
stories.summary: Zara and the brand kolor have launched a collaborative collection featuring items for men, women, and children. Creative director Taro Horiuchi designed the line around the concept of World Uniform, remixing classic styles like workwear and sportswear through the use of high-quality fabrics and tailored elements.

stories.title: GIVA secures $100 mn+ funding in a record investment in the new-age jewellery sector - The Retail Jeweller India
Zavya raises ₹22.6 crore to expand omnichannel sterling silver jewellery retail - The Retail Jeweller India
QWEEN backs the value of natural diamonds and gemstones with five-year price protection - The Retail Jeweller India
Eugenie Niarchos debuts First Light diamond collection
stories.summary: Venyx founder Eugenie Niarchos is launching First Light, a diamond collection featuring old-fashioned cuts and unconventional shapes. The designer claims the collection explores how light is captured, transformed and revealed through stone geometry. The pieces use brushed gold and black rhodium to highlight the character of the stones.

stories.title: HUWA creates bespoke jewellery for GQ Men of the Year
stories.summary: GQ Middle East commissioned Hisham Wali of Egyptian design house HUWA to create bespoke jewellery for its 2026 Men of the Year honourees. The publication sought items for guests who already possess stacked shelves of recognition. The awards ceremony took place in Cairo this year.

stories.title: Awareness Avenue expands from niche jewellery to global brand
stories.summary: Mikkel Guldberg Hansen launched Awareness Avenue in 2016, initially focusing on mental health-themed pieces like semicolon-inspired designs. The company now offers a range of accessories including moissanite engagement rings and birthstone jewellery. The founder reports the brand has served more than 310,000 customers since its inception.

stories.title: Griffin Jewellery Designs Celebrates Grand Opening of Its Largest Store in Canada - GlobeNewswire
Babs Art Gallery highlights jewellery as wearable art
stories.summary: Barbara Lo Bianco founded the Babs Art Gallery in Milan to showcase artist-designed jewellery. The gallery positions itself as a destination for those who view jewellery as an expression of uniqueness. It remains one of the few spaces globally dedicated to the intersection of contemporary art and jewellery.

stories.title: Kate Rose Fine Jewelry redesigns inherited heirlooms
stories.summary: Former teacher Kate Price founded Kate Rose Fine Jewelry in 2019 to repurpose inherited pieces into everyday wearable items. Price says she focuses on listening to the stories behind the heirlooms. With the holidays approaching, the studio has about 10 redesign slots remaining before Christmas.

stories.title: G-SHOCK releases GMC-2500 and GAC-2500 series
stories.summary: G-SHOCK is releasing the GMC-2500 and GAC-2500, a watch series featuring a sculpted metal case inspired by the Japanese rhinoceros beetle. The brand maintains its 1983 promise to build a watch that will not break. The new models include a Multi-Mission Date window for tracking elapsed time.

Swiss Snowfall Watches - Trend Hunter
Best Black Friday Watch Deals At Every Price - WatchPro
Tatler releases 2026 Watches and Jewellery Guide
stories.summary: Tatler has published its 2026 Watches and Jewellery Guide, noting a trend toward Georgian silhouettes and darkened settings. The publication suggests that jewellery remains a constant form of self-expression used to announce identity and status. The past is currently described as proving particularly seductive to contemporary designers.

stories.title: Letter jewellery gains popularity as personalised accessory
stories.summary: Initial and monogrammed jewellery is being positioned as the ultimate form of self-expression. Designers are currently revisiting the golden age of Hollywood, where starlets used gem-encrusted motifs as badges of glamour. The practice of wearing monograms against the skin is described as both ancient and entirely modern.

stories.title: Vivienne Westwood jewellery remains a fashion staple
stories.summary: Vivienne Westwood’s three-strand pearl choker with an orb centrepiece continues to be a recurring accessory among the brand's clientele. The design evolved from a single string in 1987 to the trio debuted in 1990. It remains a standard choice for galas and soirées.

stories.title: Beaded necklaces find favour in high-society fashion
stories.summary: Beaded necklaces are being highlighted as a preferred accessory for the modern elite. The trend draws inspiration from 20th-century socialites like Marella Agnelli, who was famously captured by Richard Avedon. The style is presented as a contrast to traditional diamond-heavy jewellery collections.

stories.title: Jewellery Arabia returns to Bahrain for 34th edition
stories.summary: Jewellery Arabia and Scent Arabia have returned to Exhibition World Bahrain for an eight-hall showcase running until November 28, 2026. The event features more than 750 exhibitors displaying fine jewellery, watches and fragrances. The organisers are promoting the event as a destination for retail therapy.

stories.title: Indian textile exporters rush US shipments to beat proposed 25% tariff
stories.summary: Exporters are rushing shipments to the US to avoid a proposed 25% tariff. The industry claims existing capacity is necessary for domestic demand, despite allegations of excess. With profit margins already squeezed by rising raw material costs, exporters say they cannot afford to absorb the new duties.

stories.title: Centre aims to expand India’s textile market to 350 billion dollars by 2030-31
stories.summary: Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh announced a government target to reach a 350 billion dollar textile market by 2030-31. The plan involves accelerating growth across handlooms, handicrafts, and the broader textile industry. Officials are currently reviewing the progress of state departments and the Cotton Corporation of India.

stories.title: UP Khadi Minister calls fabric a concept of self-respect
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Khadi Minister Rakesh Sachan stated that Khadi is a powerful concept of self-respect and self-reliance rather than just a fabric. He credited Mahatma Gandhi for using it to fight for independence and noted that Prime Minister Modi has given the sector new momentum since 2014.

stories.title: India and Bangladesh dispute geographical indication rights for Tangail saree
stories.summary: India and Bangladesh are both asserting geographical indication rights over the Tangail saree. The handwoven garment, known for its delicate motifs and crisp texture, has become the subject of a legal challenge in the Madras High Court. A weaving tradition is now a contest over intellectual property.

stories.title: Ranchi startup Ekokintsuki gains attention for leather waste fashion
stories.summary: Ranchi-based startup Ekokintsuki is gaining attention for transforming discarded leather scraps into shoes and handbags. The venture, founded by Dushyant Singh, recently showcased its sustainable approach at the India International Trade Fair in New Delhi and received recognition from Forbes for its efforts in circular fashion.

stories.title: Somya Goyal explores nature and impermanence through Ilume
stories.summary: Designer Somya Goyal showcased her latest collection, Ilume, at Lakme Fashion Week. The edit uses sculptural silhouettes and handwoven textiles to explore the philosophy of impermanence. The color palette features yellow, off-white, and cobalt to represent natural elements like the sun, air, and water.

stories.title: India's proposed 16,000 crore fibre plan awaits approval
stories.summary: The proposed 16,000 crore National Fibre Scheme for 2026 to 2031 remains pending with no finalized rules or allocations. While the plan covers various fibres, it is unclear how much support man-made output will receive. Investors are advised to wait for policy clarity before committing capital to new capacity.

stories.title: Bangladesh Laldia port project aims to ease apparel export costs
stories.summary: Construction on the 760 million dollar Laldia Container Terminal is scheduled to begin in February. The project aims to add one-quarter to current port capacity and handle larger vessels. Sourcing teams are advised to maintain existing lead-time assumptions, as the terminal will not be operational for years.

stories.title: India's cotton production faces fourth consecutive annual decline
stories.summary: Cotton production is estimated at 24.866 million bales for the 2025-26 season, down 14.33 percent from previous projections. Declining productivity is cited as the primary driver for the shortfall. The area under cultivation is also shrinking, marking the fourth straight year of falling output for the country.

stories.title: Beyond Fashion’s Bleak Sustainability Headlines - The Business of Fashion
The reverse supply chain and the cost of textile waste
stories.summary: Fashion trend cycles have accelerated due to social media, leading to increased closet cleanouts and donations. While consumers often view donation as a way to provide garments a second life, the volume of discarded clothing frequently exceeds the capacity of the secondary market to absorb it.

stories.title: Primark publishes sustainability and ethics progress report
stories.summary: Primark has released its 2025/26 Sustainability and Ethics Progress Report, detailing efforts to decarbonize its operations and manage chemicals. The retailer, which operates in 21 countries, states it aims to halve carbon emissions across its value chain while maintaining its current value-focused business model.

stories.title: Fashion for Good launches footwear data project to boost carbon reporting - Just Style
Fashion For Good launches Project Footprints Unpacked scheme, supported by New Balance - FashionNetwork France
Marie Curie charity shop hosts sustainable fashion pop-up
stories.summary: A Marie Curie charity shop in Swansea is hosting a three-month pop-up store offering items for as little as 20p. The initiative aims to provide a final chance for wearable goods that have completed their standard sales cycle in other charity locations before they are removed from inventory.

stories.title: 3D modeling questions Viking 'fast fashion' - Phys.org
Miss Diva announces finalists for upcycling sub-contest
stories.summary: The Miss Diva 2026 competition has announced the top three finalists for its quick upcycling sub-contest. Participants were tasked with transforming existing materials into new fashion creations. Vidhi Suthar, Uma Kushwah, and Kago Reela were selected for their resourcefulness and ability to innovate with available textiles.

stories.title: Public radio program examines the hold of fast fashion
stories.summary: A special broadcast of the program Embodied explores why fast fashion remains popular despite well-documented issues regarding worker exploitation and environmental damage. The segment features industry insider Amanda Lee discussing consumer behavior and potential alternatives to the current fast-paced retail model.

stories.title: EXCLUSIVE: Global fashion brands shift orders from Bangladesh to India amid unrest - Reuters
Fashion brands shift production from Bangladesh to India
stories.summary: Global retailers including Zara and H&M have moved orders worth $254 million out of Bangladesh following labour unrest and rising costs. India has emerged as the primary beneficiary of the shift. The move represents nearly a tenth of Bangladesh’s monthly garment orders. Production is currently mobile.

stories.title: Bangladesh garment orders decline amid labour unrest
stories.summary: Fashion retailers have diverted $254 million in orders from Bangladesh to hubs like India due to labour unrest and rising production costs. The shift occurred between November 1 and 18. The garment industry accounts for over 80 percent of Bangladesh’s export earnings. Stability is currently being re-evaluated.

stories.title: Shein to pay $100 million in FTC settlement
stories.summary: Shein has agreed to a $100 million settlement with the Federal Trade Commission over allegations of deceptive business practices. The FTC cited issues including shipping delays, suppressed reviews and unsubstantiated claims regarding cotton traceability. The commission is now seeking to overhaul the company’s U.S. business practices.

stories.title: Armani heirs consider stake purchase
stories.summary: Heirs of Giorgio Armani are considering purchasing a portion of the 15 percent stake in the fashion house currently up for sale. The sale is stipulated in the founder’s will. L’Oreal holds the licence for the brand’s fragrances and skincare products. The family remains involved in the house.

stories.title: Puig to acquire majority stake in Artessence
stories.summary: Puig has agreed to acquire 75 percent of Artessence, the parent company of Parfums de Marly and Initio, for 1.2 billion euros. The deal values the company at approximately $1.9 billion. The transaction is expected to close in the second quarter of 2027. Niche fragrance categories are currently percolating.

stories.title: When a Fashion Reboot Stalls, Who Should Take the Blame? - The Business of Fashion
Ncuti Gatwa to host BFC's Fashion Awards next week - FashionNetwork - The World's Fashion Business News
Scoop fashion trade show returns in 2027
stories.summary: Buyers from international department stores including Printemps and Liberty are preparing for the February 2027 edition of the Scoop fashion trade show. The event will be held at Olympia National from February 16 to 18. It aims to facilitate discovery and connections between designers and retail buyers.

stories.title: Fashion firms increase adoption of generative AI
stories.summary: Generative AI has reached the fashion industry after a period of being fashionably late. Meta’s Muse agent has expanded to six countries following 10 million downloads in the U.S. within 40 days. The technology is being positioned as a defining tool for the current era of fashion growth.

stories.title: Indian shoppers seek AI tools for festive retail
stories.summary: An InMobi study found 80 percent of festive shoppers in India want an AI shopping assistant. Smart search suggestions were the most popular feature, requested by 89 percent of respondents. Virtual try-ons and complete-the-look tools also saw high demand. Personalization is now a standard expectation for the festive season.

stories.title: AI tools target fashion design and marketing
stories.summary: Specialized AI platforms are being marketed to fashion brands to streamline design, photography and trend forecasting. The tools aim to replace traditional creative resources and production budgets. The industry is now focusing on connecting these creative AI decisions with commercial outcomes.

stories.title: Mirror Experience launches real-time virtual try-on
stories.summary: Mirror Experience is rolling out an AI mirror that provides virtual try-ons at 25 frames per second. The company claims its system allows garments to move with the shopper in real time. Most existing systems rely on static images that require up to 20 seconds to render.

stories.title: Google Gemini adds photo styling prompts
stories.summary: Google Gemini now allows users to upload photos and apply styles using text prompts. The tool adjusts lighting, clothing and backgrounds to create cinematic or retro effects. The company suggests these prompts save time for users who lack professional editing skills. Editing is now a matter of instruction.

stories.title: Chatbots offer facial analysis via selfies
stories.summary: Users are increasingly uploading selfies to chatbots for facial analysis, including suggestions for hairstyles and makeup. The process involves pasting text instructions into AI tools to evaluate facial ratios and skin tones. Dedicated AI analyzers are also available for those seeking automated commentary on their physical features.

stories.title: Shein re-enters Indian market via partnership
stories.summary: Shein returned to India in February 2025 through a partnership with Reliance Industries. The model focuses on local sourcing and technology access to manage product cycles. The company is attempting to navigate a competitive online market while avoiding the inventory mismatches common in fast fashion.

stories.title: Cyberattacks hit South Korean financial sector
stories.summary: Regulators in South Korea have recorded 40 cyberattacks across 37 financial firms since September. Researchers linked the incidents to an AI-powered tool named Artex. Industry executives suggest that for banks, trust now depends on the speed of detection and repair rather than the prevention of all intrusions.

stories.title: Style Union raises $52.2M Series E to expand beyond southern India - Dealroom
Bloom Hotels raises Rs 700 crore for expansion
stories.summary: Delhi-based Bloom has raised $75 million from Kedaara Capital to expand its portfolio to 12,000 rooms. The company uses a cloud-based platform developed before its first hotel opened to manage operations. It is now scaling its technology-led model to meet its future room count targets.

stories.title: Italy attempts to grow its startup ecosystem
stories.summary: Italy is using government funding and new programmes to attract international founders and develop innovative industries. The country aims to move beyond its reputation for food and fashion by helping businesses turn ideas into long-term success. The ecosystem is currently in the process of being built.

stories.title: Sequent raises $2.2 million for software safety
stories.summary: London startup Sequent has raised $2.2 million to develop an AI platform that searches for mathematical proofs to verify code safety. Founded in January 2026, the company plans to use the funds for its full product launch and recruitment. Software now requires a mathematical safety net.

stories.title: Swiss AI startup nextesy raises $10.4M from Swisscom Ventures to automate bookkeeping for SMEs - Tech Funding News
Dani Barretto's Wellness Whispers Scores Funding from Foxmont Capital Partners - esquiremag.ph
Kiaasa Retail lands Rs 45 crore export order
stories.summary: Women’s ethnic wear retailer Kiaasa Retail has secured a Rs 45 crore order from Dubai-based Gawgee Brothers. The deal covers the supply of dresses, kurtas and other lifestyle products. The order represents a significant expansion of the retailer's export reach into the Dubai textile market.

stories.title: Bodycare Creations to build garment unit in Odisha
stories.summary: The Odisha government approved a Rs 225 crore investment from Bodycare Creations to build a manufacturing facility in Khordha. The plant aims for an annual capacity of 66 million pieces and 5,500 jobs. The company currently produces 15 million pieces per year at its other locations.

stories.title: ZIFF launches founders-only networking franchise
stories.summary: The Zorion International Founders Forum has opened franchise opportunities for its networking platform. The model restricts chapters to one founder per business category to ensure exclusivity. The founders describe the concept as a way for participants to help one another while building their own local chapters.
